cadet.power: Power: keeps the lights and the base running.
cadet.lifeSupport: Life Support: keeps the crew breathing, fed, and warm.
cadet.incidentCommand: Incident Command: this is where you fix problems when they happen.
cadet.comms: Comms: talking to Earth, even with a delay.
cadet.missionCommand: Mission Command: who's doing what, and how the mission is going.

specialist.power: Power: generation, battery, and which systems shed load first if demand outruns supply.
specialist.lifeSupport: Life Support: oxygen, CO₂, water, food, and cabin temperature — the crew's survival margins.
specialist.incidentCommand: Incident Command: where you resolve incidents as they're detected, and set crew shelter/EVA status.
specialist.comms: Comms: the Earth link, light-time delay, and what gets downlink priority during a blackout.
specialist.missionCommand: Mission Command: crew station assignments, the daily plan, and progress toward mission goals.

commander.power: Power: generation/demand balance, battery state of charge, and the load-shed priority order.
commander.lifeSupport: Life Support: pO₂/pCO₂, potable water and food margins, and habitat thermal control.
commander.incidentCommand: Incident Command: response queue for detected incidents; per-crew habitat/shelter/EVA state.
commander.comms: Comms: light-time delay and downlink priority ranking, binding only during a blackout window.
commander.missionCommand: Mission Command: station coverage and assignment, the sol's rollup plan, and scored goal progress.
